biomarkers.name: Functional hormone (insulin, gastrin, VIP, glucagon, somatostatin)
biomarkers.prevalence: Subset (~10-30% functional overall; insulinoma is the most common functional pNET)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Insulinoma (hypoglycaemia), gastrinoma (ZES — refractory ulcers, diarrhoea), VIPoma (Verner-Morrison syndrome), glucagonoma (necrolytic migratory erythema, diabetes), somatostatinoma. Monitoring per hormone

biomarkers.name: SSTR2
biomarkers.clinical_use: DOTATATE PET; SSA; PRRT; everolimus, sunitinib also active in pNETs

biomarkers.name: VHL, TSC (germline)
biomarkers.clinical_use: VHL: pNET + RCC + phaeo + haemangioblastoma. TSC: pNET + other TSC manifestations

biomarkers.name: Somatic: MEN1, DAXX/ATRX, mTOR pathway
biomarkers.prevalence: MEN1 ~35-45%; DAXX/ATRX ~20-40%; mTOR pathway genes (e.g. TSC2, PTEN, PIK3CA) ~10-20%
biomarkers.clinical_use: DAXX/ATRX loss associates with ALT and adverse prognosis in many series. mTOR pathway alterations are biologically relevant in pNETs, but are not established predictive biomarkers for everolimus benefit

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Organoid or trabecular growth of monomorphic cells with salt-and-pepper chromatin, arising in pancreatic islet cells

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Pancreatic islet cells (β cells, α cells, δ cells, PP cells, ε cells) or their common progenitors
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — foregut derivative (pancreatic islets from same pancreatic buds as exocrine pancreas)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Well-differentiated neuroendocrine — synaptophysin+, chromogranin+, often high SSTR2 expression, Ki-67 <3%; functional subtypes have specific hormone production (insulinoma, glucagonoma, gastrinoma, VIPoma, somatostatinoma)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Position on well-differentiated end of pancreatic NET spectrum; MEN1 germline predisposes to multifocal pancreatic NETs
